reasoning: This project is a Kubernetes operator for Apache Spark. The README describes declarative SparkApplication resources and reconciliation of Spark workloads, PROJECT declares controller-managed namespaced custom resources (SparkConnect, SparkApplication, and ScheduledSparkApplication), and the Go entrypoints start the controller and admission webhook. The API types and generated CRD define the Spark custom-resource schema, while Kustomize and Helm manifests deploy the controller, webhook, RBAC, and CRDs. These are defining characteristics of an operator rather than a standalone service, library, or configuration-only project.
